description: Discover the unparalleled capability and refined luxury of the 2020 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4. This rugged yet sophisticated pickup is engineered to conquer any terrain while delivering a premium driving experience.  Outfitted with a robust 3.0L Duramax Turbo Diesel engine and 4-wheel drive, the Sierra AT4 delivers impressive power and exceptional off-road performance. Key features include:  - Onyx Black exterior with Black accents - Engine Block Heater - AT4 Premium Package with LT275/65R18C MT blackwall Goodyear Wrangler DuraTrac tires and 6" Black rectangular assist steps  Beyond its impressive capabilities, this Sierra AT4 is packed with luxurious amenities to elevate your driving experience:  - Bose 7-speaker premium audio system - Heated and ventilated front seats - Heated rear outboard seats - Power sunroof - Wireless charging - Rear Camera Mirror - Head-up display  With its muscular stance, advanced technology, and premium cabin appointments, the 2020 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4 is a true masterpiece of automotive engineering. Experience the perfect blend of capability and refinement - visit our showroom today to take this exceptional truck for a test drive.  The Sierra AT4's impressive performance is matched by its refined interior, offering the ultimate in comfort and convenience. Sink into the plush, perforated leather-appointed seats and enjoy the convenience of dual-zone climate control, power-adjustable front seats with memory, and a heated steering wheel. The premium Bose audio system delivers concert-hall sound, while the 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system with built-in navigation and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto keeps you connected on the go.  Beyond its creature comforts, the Sierra AT4 is engineered to tackle the toughest terrain. The off-road-tuned suspension, locking rear differential, and Goodyear Wrangler DuraTrac tires provide exceptional grip and control, while features like Hill Descent Control and the in-vehicle trailering app make towing and off-road adventures a breeze. With the available 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot, you can stay connected even in the most remote locations.  Safety is also a top priority in the Sierra AT4, with a comprehensive suite of advanced driver assistance technologies. Enjoy the peace of mind of features like Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert, and Rear Cross Traffic Alert, all designed to help you navigate the road with confidence.  Whether you're seeking a capable off-road companion or a refined daily driver, the 2020 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4 delivers uncompromising performance, technology, and luxury. Visit our showroom today to experience this exceptional truck for yourself and discover why the Sierra AT4 is the ultimate choice for those who demand the best. description: I was 33 years old working in the private sector and after yet another bad car buying experience I was fed up! I wanted to start a different kind of car company built on Christian ethics and morals. Our faith guides us, but I tell people all of the time that we love Jesus and set out to honor Him, but that doesn't mean your car will last forever! Lol! What it means is that we are always going to be honest and transparent with you. I am a Veteran and a patriot and believe in old fashioned business practices. I wanted to set out to provide a high quality, used car without all of the dealer tricks and deception.  What I found is that other people wanted that too! By being honest and transparent we built our small business into the largest independent dealership in the state. In late 2018 my wife and I sold our business in Indiana and moved to Florida with the dreams of doing the same model here while being closer to our family. We did it with the Lords wisdom and help! Our company is called Trade Guru because we specialize in new car trade-ins. If you don't know the difference between a new car trade-in and a normal car at the auction, it is a very important distinction. We look for cars that people trade in just because they want a new one not because there's something wrong with it. We don't buy from independent dealers who are trying to hide their sins and pawn their broken cars off onto other people. Florida is full of nice, low mileage, one owner cars and that's what we specialize in. We mostly buy from local, high-line, luxury car dealerships.  These are the cars that people paid 40k to 90k for and have been taken care. That's what we want to give you as the second owner! We look for one to two owner vehicles with documented service histories and CarFax's. We allow you to take our cars to a mechanic to help you make a wise decision for you and your family. We price our cars using Kelly blue book and J.D. Power. If you look at CarGurus website, all of our cars are beyond fair deals, as they call them! We have our own experienced technicians, interior upholstery workers, body workers, as well as tire and brake workers to help service your cars needs.  You name it and we can do it all. The Subaru had an easy time getting up to speed and showed no signs of running out of steam on grades or twisty roads. You'll have plenty of power for freeway passing maneuvers and getting on the highway, and this engine serves as a good compromise of power, capability and fuel economy. Straight-line driving is relaxed and comfortable, the interior is quiet, and the seats have the right support for use on day-long drives. Visibility is quite good in all directions, plus the A-pillar is narrow enough to make room for a larger glass area, which allows the driver to see more of the road at the front corners.The 2020 Ascent also shows signs of sportiness, with its handling, steering and braking. On twisty roads, the handling and quick steering response make this 3-row SUV feel agile, like a smaller vehicle. Braking is also quite good, responsive without being touchy, and there's no mushy pedal feel.Interior ComfortThis 2020 Subaru Ascent has an interior that is warm and welcoming, yet highly practical with seating for seven passengers. Controls are a mix of easy-to-reach buttons and knobs. Niceties include 3-zone climate control (standard), seat heaters and a panoramic moonroof. Seat materials are either cloth, spill-repellent cloth, or leather. Apple CarPlay is standard. The third row is easy to access, thanks to doors that open wide and a pleasantly low step-in height. There's enough knee room for kids, but it's tight for taller adults  unless you politely ask a 2nd-row passenger to slide his seat forward.The rear seats basically fold flat  flatter if you opt for the regular bench instead of the more-bolstered captain's chairs  and when folded, create room for more than 86 cubic feet of cargo. That's more volume than in the Highlander, Explorer and Pilot, but a bit shy of the new Kia Telluride. The cargo area has a nice, wide opening that makes loading gear a snap, as well as an available power liftgate. There's even a storage cubby under the load floor where you can stow the cargo area cover when it's not in use.Exterior StylingWhen you see the new Ascent, you will know right away it's a Subaru. It's larger than an Outback, but the proportions and shape are similar. There are four trim levels: base, Premium, Limited and Touring. Roof rails and 18-inch wheels are standard; 20-inch wheels are available. This Limited model has LED headlights and fog lights, plus lower-door cladding with chrome accents. Available upgrades include blind-spot detection, reverse automatic braking, rear cross-traffic assist, a front-view monitor and auto high-beam assist.REAR-SEAT REMINDERThis simple but vital standard feature operates by detecting if either of the rear doors has been opened and closed within 30 minutes of the following three scenarios: starting the car, the vehicle is running and stationary or the vehicle is turned off and back on again while the rear doors remain closed.
